newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK seven-year notes avg accepted yield 6.91 pct.
newsitem.headline: HK seven-year notes avg accepted yield 6.91 pct.

text.p: The Hong Kong Monetary Authority said the average accepted price of the seven-year Exchange Fund notes tendered on Monday was 100.03 yielding 6.91 percent versus 7.42 percent at a previous tender in August.
Bids for the HK$500 million issue totalled HK$4.65 billion versus HK$2.80 billion at the last tender.
The lowest accepted yield was 6.91 percent, while the average tendered yield was 6.92 percent, it said.
The notes carry a coupon of 6.80 percent and mature on November 26, 2003.
